# forward_network (Resource)

A Forward network. Everything else — cloud accounts, snapshots, checks — belongs to one.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Network name. Changing it replaces the network, and its snapshots with it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier Forward assigns the network.
- `org_id` (String) Organization the network belongs to.
